tasks.title: Operational Incident & SLO Dashboard
tasks.prompt: Build an Operational Incident & SLO Dashboard with a 7D/30D/90D window switcher, primary Mean Time to Recovery (MTTR) KPI, 30-day error-budget burn rate time-series chart with accessible data table, paired P95 latency and SLO uptime KPIs, ranked service blast-radius breakdown, and an active incident responder table.

tasks.title: Organization Security & Billing Preferences
tasks.prompt: Build an Organization Security & Billing Preferences screen with a top security posture summary and quiet operational configuration sections for SSO & Passkey Enforcement, Invoice Routing & Spend Caps, and Audit Log Retention, including linked form fields, switches, radio group, validation notice, and save/reset actions.

tasks.title: Webhook Delivery & Event Stream Console
tasks.prompt: Build a Webhook Delivery & Event Stream Console with environment toggle (PROD/STAGE), delivery success KPI, 24h webhook throughput & retry time-series chart, ranked destination endpoint breakdown, and a filterable, paginated event delivery log table with semantic status tags.

tasks.title: Multi-Region Inventory & Fulfillment Ledger
tasks.prompt: Build a Multi-Region Inventory & Fulfillment Ledger with regional fill-rate KPIs, backorder volume trend chart, fulfillment center performance list, and a high-density filterable SKU allocation table with search, region filter, pagination, and zero-match empty state.

tasks.title: Developer Platform Product Launch & Pricing Page
tasks.prompt: Build a Developer Platform Product Launch & Pricing Page with an establishing hero value proposition and live throughput benchmark chart, paired latency/reliability proof points, an annotated architecture callout, a plan comparison table, and an interactive seat/volume tier switcher.

tasks.title: Production Deployment & Rollout Wizard
tasks.prompt: Build a Production Deployment & Rollout Wizard with hierarchical breadcrumb navigation, 3-step rollout configuration (Target Artifact, Canary Traffic Policy, Pre-Flight Signoff), accessible form controls (Input, Select, RadioGroup, Checkbox, Switch, Textarea), readiness notice, and a modal deployment confirmation dialog.

conditions.label: Condition 1: Conventional shadcn/Tailwind Baseline
conditions.description: Conventional React + CSS utility card/table/form baseline without FRAME/12 components. Evaluated strictly on universal UI quality metrics (build, TypeScript, axe WCAG AA, contrast, keyboard reachability, 1280px/390px overflow) and marked N/A on FRAME/12-specific grammar rules.

conditions.label: Condition 2: FRAME/12 Components Without SKILL.md
conditions.description: Uses @/components/frame12 components from component names/types alone without reading skills/frame12/SKILL.md or running scripts/check-frame12.mjs.

conditions.label: Condition 3: FRAME/12 Components With SKILL.md (Single-Pass)
conditions.description: Guided by skills/frame12/SKILL.md before running the automated static checker.

conditions.label: Condition 4: FRAME/12 Components With SKILL.md + check-frame12.mjs
conditions.description: Guided by skills/frame12/SKILL.md and verified with scripts/check-frame12.mjs + Playwright feedback loop.
